Metadata.title: Adriane Almeida Gonçalves — Full-Stack Developer
Metadata.description: Full-stack portfolio of Adriane Almeida Gonçalves: React, Next.js, and Node.js. Web, mobile, and REST APIs. Lisbon, Portugal.

Home.heroBio: I build digital products that solve real problems. From idea to deployment, I use React, Node.js, and TypeScript to turn complex challenges into simple, well-crafted solutions.
Home.heroImageAlt: Illustration of Adriane working on a laptop in a beanbag chair beside a bookshelf
Home.title: Full-Stack Developer
Home.description: Software Engineer with 2+ years shipping web and mobile products (React, TypeScript, React Native) and a growing focus on Node.js backends — REST APIs, integrations, and server-side logic in the JavaScript ecosystem.

About.subtitle: About Me
About.title: Full-Stack Developer · React & Node.js
About.description: Software Engineer with a strong front-end foundation (React, TypeScript, Next.js, React Native) and an active move into full-stack with Node.js: consuming and designing REST APIs, server-side logic, and data validation. Experience on digital commerce platforms, mobile apps, and production back-end integrations. Redux, Tailwind, Radix UI, Git, and Azure DevOps in Agile teams. Full Stack Web Bootcamp (Labenu, 2023).

studyCard.title: Continuous learning
studyCard.description: Deepening back-end skills with Node.js (APIs, persistence, and best practices). BSc in Computer Engineering at IPS (2027), Labenu Full Stack Bootcamp (2023), and Front-End Immersion with AI (Alura, 2026).

Projects.subtitle: Projects
Projects.title: Featured Work
Projects.description: From full-stack web (Next.js + Node.js) to mobile and AI — projects centered on APIs, TypeScript, and end-to-end delivery.

project4.title: Full-stack portfolio
project4.description: Personal site built with Next.js 16, i18n, dark/light theme, and a contact form with Zod validation and email delivery via Node.js Server Actions and Resend.

project1.title: SerPlena — Women's Health Diary
project1.description: React Native mobile app to track, record, and visualize daily physical and emotional well-being metrics, built at Teamsoft Technology and Systems.

project2.title: Facial Expression Recognition (CNN)
project2.description: Computer Vision pipeline using the FER-2013 dataset, image preprocessing, and a Convolutional Neural Network in Python (TensorFlow/Keras) to classify emotions in facial images.

project3.title: Virtual Showroom — Industrial Inventory
project3.description: Mobile features for industrial inventory digitization, including an interactive virtual showroom with multi-platform deployment (Android and iOS), during an undergraduate research fellowship at IPS.

Experience.subtitle: Experience
Experience.title: Work History
Experience.description: From UI components to production features with API integration — expanding into full-stack delivery with Node.js.

item1.description: Collaborated on mobile features for industrial inventory digitization, delivering an interactive virtual showroom with Android and iOS deployment. Designed Figma layouts and prototypes focused on usability and UX.

item2.description: Engineered core features for an audiovisual asset and warehouse management platform in a digital commerce ecosystem, integrated with REST APIs and back-end business rules. Built a reporting module with dynamic filters. Developed SerPlena in React Native. Maintained legacy Angular 7. Agile, Git, and Azure DevOps.

item3.description: Supported the front-end team building UI components following modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS best practices. Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and release cycles.

Contact.subtitle: Contact
Contact.title: Let's build something together
Contact.description: I'm open to full-stack roles (Node.js + React), front-end, freelance projects, and collaborations.
